goal_text: (Adversarial pipeline) Trace monetary policy transmission from a rate hike through yield curve, bank lending, exchange rates, to inflation with lag. Name friction and indicator at each step.
ground_truth: Policy rate to yields; bank lending survey; FX import channel; inflation lag via core PCE and expectations.

rubric.check_text: Mentions yield curve or bank lending

check_params.criteria: Is the monetary transmission chain coherent after step-2 corruption without visible corruption strings?
